△ 注意 お買い上げのお客様へ 必ずお読みください。

●二次電池(充電式電池) は、 絶対に使用しないでください。

blocks.translation:
• Warning — Read this before use.
• This product is for ages 15 and up. Do not give it to children under the specified age.
• Be careful of accidental swallowing of batteries (sold separately), battery covers, screws, etc.
• There are pointed and sharp parts; handle and store the product carefully. Unexpected injuries may occur.
• Keep fingers, hair and clothing away from rotating parts to avoid getting caught.
• Do not use the product near the ear. Incorrect use may damage hearing.
• This product contains electronic parts. If you use a pacemaker, keep this product away from your body.
• Incorrect battery use may cause heating, rupture or leakage. Observe the following precautions.
• Never use secondary (rechargeable) batteries.
• Do not mix old and new batteries or batteries of different types.
• Insert batteries with the correct + and − polarity.
• After playing, always turn the switch off and remove the batteries. Leaving batteries installed may cause leakage and is dangerous.
• Do not short-circuit, charge, disassemble, heat, or throw batteries into fire.
• If battery fluid gets into your eyes, immediately rinse with plenty of water and consult a doctor. If it gets on skin or clothing, wash with water.
• When disposing of the product or batteries, follow your local municipal waste disposal instructions.
